Extensions.Title: Extensions
Extensions.Subtitle: Give the agent new tools and know-how: MCP servers, plugins, skills and slash commands.
Extensions.Empty.Title: Nothing installed yet
Extensions.Empty.Body: Add MCP servers, plugins and skills from Discover. Most of them need no key.
Extensions.NoMatches.Title: No matches
Extensions.Mcp.Title: MCP servers
Extensions.Mcp.Caption: Same format as Claude Desktop, Claude Code and Cursor. Tools appear as mcp__server__tool.
Extensions.Mcp.Empty: No servers yet. Add one from Discover, or paste an entry into mcp.json. Use ${secret:NAME} or ${env:NAME} for keys.
Extensions.Plugins.Title: Plugins
Extensions.Plugins.Caption: Claude Code plugins work as they are: skills, commands and MCP servers in one folder.
Extensions.Plugins.SourcePlaceholder: Folder, https git URL or owner/repo (a marketplace installs all its plugins, turned off)
Extensions.Skills.Title: Skills
Extensions.Skills.Caption: Folders with a SKILL.md. The agent sees each name and description, and loads the instructions only when a task needs them.
Extensions.Skills.Empty: No skills yet. Install one from Discover, or add .kam/skills or .claude/skills to your workspace.
Extensions.Commands.Title: Slash commands
Extensions.Commands.Caption: Markdown prompts you run from chat. $ARGUMENTS is replaced with what you type after the command.
Extensions.Commands.Empty: No commands yet. Save a .md file in the commands folder; review.md becomes /review.
Extensions.Discover.Servers.Caption: Free and keyless. Kam adds them to mcp.json and starts them.
Extensions.Discover.Custom: Another server? Paste its entry under mcpServers in mcp.json; the format is the same as Claude Desktop and Cursor.
Extensions.Discover.Plugins.Caption: Installed from GitHub with git, turned off. Turn on the ones you want on the Installed tab.
Extensions.Discover.FromSource.Caption: A plugin from a folder, a git URL or owner/repo, or a skill from a folder with SKILL.md.
Extensions.Catalog.fetch: Reads web pages and turns them into Markdown the agent can use.
Extensions.Catalog.filesystem: Reads, writes and searches files inside a folder you choose.
Extensions.Catalog.git: Reads the history, diffs and branches of a repository, and makes commits.
Extensions.Catalog.playwright: Drives a real browser: opens pages, clicks, fills in forms and reads what is on screen.
Extensions.Catalog.context7: Current documentation and code examples for thousands of libraries.
Extensions.Catalog.microsoft-learn: Searches Microsoft’s official docs for .NET, Azure, Windows and more.
Extensions.Catalog.deepwiki: Answers questions about any public GitHub repository from its generated wiki.
Extensions.Catalog.memory: Remembers people, projects and facts across chats in a local knowledge graph.
Extensions.Catalog.sequential-thinking: Gives the model a scratchpad to work through hard problems step by step.
Extensions.Catalog.chrome-devtools: Inspects pages in Chrome: console, network requests and performance traces.
Extensions.Catalog.time: The current time and conversions between time zones.
Extensions.Catalog.anthropic-skills: Anthropic’s skills for PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, plus a skill creator, an MCP builder and more.
Extensions.Catalog.claude-code-plugins: Anthropic’s Claude Code plugins: commit commands, code review, feature development and more.

Extensions.Message.PluginOn: Turned on {0}. Its skills, commands and servers are available from the next message.
